quality_guards: Agricultural-machinery risk depends on machine type, guarding, maintenance, task, terrain, operator competence, bystanders and operating conditions.
HSE machinery guidance is machine-, task-, operator-, site-, control- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level injury probability.
Occupational-asthma risk depends on sensitiser, concentration, exposure route, duration, controls, susceptibility and health-surveillance timing.
HSE asthma evidence is substance-, workplace-, worker-, exposure-, control- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level disease probability.
Work-stress risk depends on work design, workload, autonomy, support, relationships, role clarity, change and individual circumstances.
HSE stress evidence is organisation-, team-, role-, worker-, intervention- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level health probability.
Pesticide risk depends on product, formulation, dose, application equipment, weather, target, exposure route, PPE, storage and disposal.
HSE pesticide evidence is product-, operation-, worker-, environment-, control- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level poisoning probability.
Measles risk depends on infectious timing, immunity, vaccination history, contact intensity, setting, age and post-exposure action.
UKHSA measles evidence is case-, contact-, immunity-, setting-, intervention- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level infection probability.
Pertussis risk depends on infectious timing, age, vaccination, contact intensity, setting, symptoms, treatment and prophylaxis.
UKHSA pertussis evidence is case-, contact-, setting-, vaccine-, treatment- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level infection probability.
Hepatitis E risk depends on genotype, food and water exposure, travel, immune status, pregnancy, occupation and timing.
UKHSA hepatitis E evidence is case-, exposure-, food-, traveller-, host- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level infection probability.
Baby-sleep-product risk depends on product design, softness, ventilation, intended age, use, supervision, sleep environment and compliance.
OPSS baby-sleep evidence is product-, child-, use-, environment-, compliance- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level fatality probability.
Loss-of-control risk depends on aircraft, phase of flight, weather, loading, energy state, pilot competence, startle and system condition.
CAA loss-of-control evidence is aircraft-, pilot-, operation-, weather-, event- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level accident probability.
Train-protection risk depends on signalling, braking curves, infrastructure, rolling stock, system coverage, maintenance, operation and human performance.
ORR train-protection evidence is route-, system-, train-, operation-, maintenance- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level collision probability.
